pkgmetadata.longdescription: RealtimeTTS converts streamed text to speech in real-time using a pluggable engine architecture. Supported backends include Microsoft Edge TTS, Google TTS, OpenAI TTS, ElevenLabs, Azure Cognitive Services, Kokoro, Coqui, and various local neural TTS engines.

use.flag: Enable Microsoft Edge TTS engine via edge-tts
Enable Google Text-to-Speech engine via gTTS
